newsitem.title: FRANCE: French air force runs out of gas.
newsitem.headline: French air force runs out of gas.

text.p: The French air force has cancelled training flights until the New Year after using up its fuel budget for this year, military sources said on Saturday.
They said training flights had been halted a week ago, confining pilots to flight simulation exercises, and some airbases were cutting down on heating.
Strategic fuel reserves were maintained for emergencies and operations abroad were not affected.
"In 20 years of service, I have never seen such a drastic step," Colonel Andre de Roquefeuil, commander of an eastern air base, told France-3 television.
A Defence Ministry spokeswoman declined to comment.
France-3 said the budget had been spent because of higher than expected costs for fuel and operations in the Middle East and Bosnia.
